quest_deliver_package.title: The King's Package
quest_deliver_package.description: Carry the king's sealed package over the mountain to the mayor of Hazevale.

stages.description: Deliver the sealed package to the mayor of Hazevale.

objective.item_to_deliver_description: A small package bound in red wax. It is heavier than it looks.

stages.start_dialogue: You are handed a heavy little package, bound in red wax.
stages.completion_narration: The mayor takes the package, and something in it begins to hum.
